## Home

**Constellation Design** is a creative consultancy and product studio driven by curiosity, led by Qa'id Jacobs from Amsterdam.

The studio partners with brands to create meaningful digital experiences rooted in research, storytelling, and craft — and builds its own tools and platforms independently.

## About

Constellation Design is a creative consultancy and product studio led by **Qa'id Jacobs**, a designer, creative director, and product builder based in Amsterdam, Netherlands.

The studio brings a considered, process-led approach to every engagement. Work spans UX design, creative direction, product strategy, and facilitated workshops — often combining multiple disciplines on a single project. Beyond client work, the studio designs and builds its own tools and platforms to solve problems encountered firsthand.

The name Constellation Design reflects how ideas and people connect: individual points of light that, when seen together, form something larger and more meaningful.

---

## Services

### UX Design
Research-grounded interface and experience design. From discovery and mapping through to wireframes, prototypes, and design systems.

### Creative Direction
Visual identity, art direction, and brand expression. Shaping how a brand looks, sounds, and feels across digital and physical touchpoints.

### Product Strategy
Helping teams define what to build and why. Facilitated workshops, opportunity mapping, roadmap planning, and strategic framing.

### Workshops
Tailored working sessions for teams and organisations. Formats include design sprints, discovery workshops, brand definition, and team alignment.

---

## Work

### The Wild
**Category:** Creative Direction
**Client:** The Wild
**Role:** Creative Direction
**Year:** 2024
**Industry:** Publishing & Community

Visual exploration and promotional design for The Wild Pop-up Bookstore.

The Wild is a community pop-up bookstore concept celebrating independent publishing, marginalised voices, and the joy of reading. The project involved developing a visual language that felt alive, community-driven, and rooted in literary culture.

https://constellation.design/work/the-wild

---

### African Puzzle
**Category:** Product Strategy
**Role:** Design Lead & Product Owner
**Year:** 2024
**Industry:** Productivity & Creative Tools

Design leadership and product ownership for a personal assistant app serving artisans, creatives, and entrepreneurs across 70 countries.

African Puzzle is a personal assistant app designed for artisans, tailors, creatives, and entrepreneurs. As Design Lead and Product Owner, Qa'id shaped the product from the ground up — defining what it should be, how it should work, and why it matters. The app is available in beta on Google Play across 70 countries.

https://constellation.design/work/african-puzzle

---

### Look Ma, No Hands
**Category:** UX Design
**Role:** Designer & Developer
**Year:** 2025
**Industry:** Productivity & Developer Tools

A macOS voice dictation and meeting transcription app. 100% local processing, privacy-first, built with WhisperKit and Core ML.

Look Ma, No Hands is a native macOS app that does voice dictation and meeting transcription entirely on-device. No cloud, no accounts, no internet required. Designed and built end-to-end by Qa'id — from product definition and UX design through Swift/SwiftUI development, security hardening, and distribution via Homebrew. Open source under MIT license.

https://constellation.design/work/look-ma-no-hands

---

### ScopeMatch
**Category:** Product Strategy
**Role:** Founder & Developer
**Year:** 2025
**Industry:** Quality Assurance & Testing

A pan-European directory of ISO 17025 accredited testing laboratories. 13,700+ labs across 6 countries with AI-powered search.

ScopeMatch aggregates data from six national accreditation bodies (DAkkS, UKAS, COFRAC, RvA, ACCREDIA, ENAC) into one unified, searchable directory. The platform normalises test method references across countries and languages using AI-powered taxonomy classification. Founded and built by Qa'id.

https://constellation.design/work/scopematch

---

### Amplifon's Audiologist Dashboard
**Category:** UX Design
**Client:** Amplifon
**Role:** Design Lead
**Year:** 2023
**Industry:** Healthcare

Optimising the flows and dashboards used by audiologists to assess walk-in patients.

Amplifon is a global leader in hearing care. This project focused on redesigning the internal dashboard used by audiologists during patient consultations — reducing friction, improving information hierarchy, and supporting faster clinical decisions.

https://constellation.design/work/amplifon

---

### The Usual Hotel's User Experience
**Category:** UX Design
**Client:** The Usual Hotel
**Role:** UX Design Lead
**Year:** 2023
**Industry:** Hospitality

Establishing an experience that takes hotel guests from booking online to checking in.

The Usual Hotel is a boutique hotel concept with a focus on simplicity and warmth. This engagement covered the full digital guest journey — from discovery and booking through to on-property digital touchpoints and check-in flows.

https://constellation.design/work/the-usual-hotel

---

### Spook
**Category:** UX Design
**Role:** Designer & Developer
**Year:** 2025
**Industry:** Developer Tools & Security

A lightweight macOS network traffic monitor with per-app breakdown, connection details, and traffic history.

Spook is a macOS menu bar app that monitors network traffic in real time. Named after Sam Greenlee's 1969 novel, it shows per-app traffic breakdown, connection details with resolved hostnames, and usage graphs. Built with Swift/SwiftUI, open source. No special permissions required.

https://constellation.design/work/spook
